    "summary": "The evidence packet establishes that an air-low indication occurred at RHOB while Utilities crew U-A/U-B were preparing for maintenance but had not yet received formal release from M-A. The log (IA-S01) confirms the event timeline and status of work preparation, though it notes times are reconstructed. Reference documents (IA-D01/IA-D02/IA-D03) define system topology, measurement conventions, and change-record requirements but explicitly state they are fictional/synthetic for this exercise; thus, they cannot independently prove actual equipment behavior or policy compliance on May 20 without corroboration from operational logs. The blank temporary instruction field in IA-S02 suggests none were attached to the supplied copy, though it does not definitively rule out a requirement. No direct conflicts exist between sources regarding the event sequence; however, gaps remain regarding the origin of the pressure drop, specific valve positions, and whether a change record was active.",

    ],
